name: Can stair trim be installed on curved or unusually shaped staircases?

mainEntity.name: Can stair trim be installed on curved or unusually shaped staircases?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, stair trim can be installed on curved or unusually shaped staircases, though it requires specialized techniques and expertise. Our craftsmen are experienced in custom-fitting trim to complex geometries, often involving steaming wood to bend it or creating segmented pieces for a seamless appearance. This detailed work ensures that even the most unique staircases in homes across Star and Nampa can receive a beautifully finished trim. The precision involved is a key part of achieving a high-quality result on these types of projects.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, stair trim can be installed on curved or unusually shaped staircases using specialized techniques and custom-fitting by experienced craftsmen.
